race.comment: BENEATH THE ROCK (2) has started the season in style, winning fresh up by 3 lengths, then fighting on bravely for third off a tough trip as the favourite at Warwick Farm just over 3 weeks ago. She gets a big swing in her draw for this, and with the aid of a 2kg claim, she will be fighting out the finish again. Follow your money. KUJENGA (3) has improved in each run back from a spell, and ran on late for fourth over 1100m last start, finishing just under 2 lengths from the winner. JMac steps into the irons for the first time, and she should go close to winning this. HELLABELLA (4) was left flat-footed at Warwick Farm last time out over 1100m, and just battled on to finish seventh. The extra 150m is now what she is looking for, and she can bounce straight back into the money. HUSH HUSH (5) resumes from a spell, and she showed plenty of talent last season. She is nicely placed after a claim, so don't risk her fresh. MIDNIGHT LUNA (6) is worth including fresh.
